# tokenizers-zig (`SMC17/tokenizers-zig`)

> HuggingFace tokenizer.json in Zig 0.16: BPE, WordPiece and Unigram, differential-tested against the Rust tokenizers.

## Repository & Docs
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig
- [README](https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig/blob/main/README.md)
- [AI Inference Zig Stack](https://sunlitmoon.online/lab/ai-inference-zig-stack.html)
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md)
- [Build](https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig/blob/main/build.zig) & [Flake](https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig/blob/main/flake.nix)
- [Source](https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig/tree/main/src) & [Tests](https://github.com/SMC17/tokenizers-zig/tree/main/tests)
